movie:1050981.overview: Scrappy, defiant, and done being treated like a burden, Judy Heumann turns her outrage into a revolution. In 1977, she and more than 100 disability rights protestors send a very loud message: The system is broken—not us.

series:341828.title: Pushpaka Vimanam
series:341828.overview: Pushpak finds a way to travel through time. He makes one change in the past, which puts everything in his present at risk.

series:256726.title: Tantara
series:256726.overview: In years of crackdowns and fear, Korea's show world kept the lights on and the dream alive — fighting for a stage where grit could turn to glory.

movie:1566124.title: Madhurame Jeevitham
movie:1566124.overview: Madhuramee Jeevitham is a poignant family drama that explores aging, relationships, and the quiet beauty of everyday life.

movie:1310458.title: Saayavanam
movie:1310458.overview: Sita tries to live an honest and truthful life following all religious and social norms of her upbringing while unraveling the true agenda of men around her. In this process, she emerges victorious as a strong and brave woman.

movie:791523.title: Wildwood
movie:791523.overview: Prue and her classmate Curtis are drawn into a magical forest filled with enchanted creatures, loyal allies, and formidable adversaries as they embark on a desperate quest to rescue Prue's abducted baby brother from a murder of crows led by a mysterious woman named Alexandra.

series:291507.title: The Body
series:291507.overview: On Halloween night, an all-girls dance squad tumbles into Catholic guilt, unholy desires and ghostly visions when an initiation goes to hell.

movie:1636756.title: Mrigaya 1.5: The Hunt Continues
movie:1636756.overview: Officer-in-Charge Debanjan Dutta of the Kolkata Police and his team face mounting danger while investigating a gruesome crime that shakes their neighborhood. As twists derail the probe, a ruthless gang spreads chaos across the city. With tensions rising and violence erupting, the hunt intensifies.

movie:1117898.title: The Cat in the Hat
movie:1117898.overview: Assigned his toughest mission yet, the Cat must cheer up siblings Gabby and Sebastian as they adjust to life in a new town. Known for pushing boundaries, this agent of chaos must prove himself or risk losing his magical hat forever.

movie:1518204.title: Allen
movie:1518204.overview: 20 years after his encounter with an alien, Petey never moved on. Now his old friend has returned, and the reason why is complicated — and unexpected.

movie:1610874.title: Heggana Muddu
movie:1610874.overview: Ajitha and Prerana's union quickly unravels when mysteries and misunderstandings take over. Humor meets tension as they confront shocking revelations about love, loyalty, and the strangers hiding behind familiar faces.

movie:970347.title: The Killer
movie:970347.overview: Zee is a feared contract killer known as "the Queen of the Dead," but when she refuses to murder a young blind woman, she finds herself hunted both by criminal colleagues and a determined police detective.

movie:1542674.title: Anumana Pakshi
movie:1542674.overview: Follows a man whose parents want to send him away as a house husband. A girl falls in love with him, but the story takes an unexpected turn involving investigation thriller elements.

movie:1380163.title: Pendulum
movie:1380163.overview: A couple, journeys to a retreat in New Mexico seeking healing. Patrick grows skeptical of the retreat's leader as Abigail falls under her influence. They wonder if the group's practices offer genuine healing or conceal a terrifying truth.

movie:1772904.title: Happy Journey
movie:1772904.overview: Seven women from different generations leave their daily routines behind for a spontaneous getaway that sparks a journey of friendship and self-discovery.

movie:1640396.title: Prem Keetanu
movie:1640396.overview: A group of young men and their turbulent college life, where bad grades and hopelessness remain in the driver's seat. Even as they pursue love, friendship and aspirations, the film promises to capture the current generation's struggles and dreams in a light-hearted yet heartfelt manner.

movie:1280115.title: Way of the Warrior Kid
movie:1280115.overview: Jake is an injured Navy SEAL who becomes a mentor for his shy, struggling nephew Marc. Using the principles of his military training, Jake teaches Marc how to be a Warrior Kid as he enters high school.

movie:1576377.title: Jetlee
movie:1576377.overview: An attendant on a flight from Dubai to Kochi gets caught up in a dangerous situation.

movie:1025125.title: Kishkindha Kaandam
movie:1025125.overview: Strange events unfold in a monkey-inhabited village, driving a newlywed couple and forest officials to embark on a mission to uncover the root of the unusual disturbances.

series:288672.title: Pride and Prejudice
series:288672.overview: Elizabeth Bennet is an unmarried woman and the second of five daughters of Mr and Mrs Bennet from Hertfordshire, near London. The Bennet home can only be inherited by males in the family, so the pressure is on for the daughters to marry well or risk losing everything. While out in society, Elizabeth interacts with single men like Mr Darcy, an outwardly, misunderstood curmudgeon.

movie:1551025.title: Guarding Stars
movie:1551025.overview: When a no-nonsense bodyguard is assigned to protect a charming action star over the holidays, sparks fly, secrets unravel, and Christmas gets a whole lot more complicated.

movie:1300968.title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
movie:1300968.original_title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
movie:1300968.overview: Return to the world of Panem 24 years before Katniss Everdeen volunteers in her sister's place, commencing on the morning of the reaping of the 50th Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell.

series:103540.title: Percy Jackson and the Olympians
series:103540.overview: Percy Jackson is on a dangerous quest. Outrunning monsters and outwitting gods, he must journey across America to return Zeus's master bolt and stop an all-out war. movie:1437511.title: How to Rob a Bank
movie:1437511.overview: A crew of social media-savvy bank robbers broadcasts their daring heists, unaware that their growing viral fame has put them in the crosshairs of a veteran FBI agent and a brilliant software engineer. Despite the unlikely duo closing in, the crime ring pushes past their limits, putting everything on the line for their most ambitious heist yet.

movie:940009.title: Ray Gunn
movie:940009.overview: In Metropia, a gigantic city in an alternate future as seen from 1939, private eye Raymond Gunn is drawn into a case involving aliens, murder and a multimedia star named Venus Nova.

series:335981.title: Cunk on Cinema
series:335981.overview: Philomena Cunk asks experts all of the hard-hitting questions about the history of cinema, from the invention of the camera, to the New Wave filmmakers of the 60s, right up to the entrance of CGI and what the future of AI holds. Cunk will attempt to demystify it all while sitting in lumpy seats with stale popcorn, asking herself where did cinema come from? And why? What does it want? And why can't it tell us?

movie:1722975.title: Kla Kla Klee Klee Nazriya Thirinjunookki
movie:1722975.original_title: Kla Kla Klee Klee Nazriya Thirinjunookki
movie:1722975.overview: When office colleagues Adithyan and Nazriya fall for each other, their romance quickly spirals into a whirlwind of unpredictable twists and absolute chaos.

movie:1778302.title: Chiram
movie:1778302.overview: Seetha, a young Malayali research student who travels to Visva-Bharati University in Kolkata to study traditional Baul music and culture.

series:224377.title: Harry Potter
series:224377.overview: There is nothing special about Harry Potter - at least that's what his Aunt Petunia always says. On his 11th birthday, a letter of admittance to Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry opens up a hidden world for Harry: one of fun, friendship and magic. But with this new adventure comes great risk as Harry is forced to face a dangerous enemy from his past.

series:238108.title: Call Me Bae

movie:1655020.title: John Doe

movie:1428301.title: #Single

series:338502.title: Mr & Mrs Office
series:338502.overview: Mr & Mrs Office explores the comedic and chaotic worlds of work-life balance, relationships, and corporate dynamics. The plot centers around a couple navigating the daily grind, combining relatable office tropes with domestic humor and romance.

movie:1521938.title: The Gift
movie:1521938.overview: Desi, Samara, and Aurora, three Roma women, go down to the city center to buy a gift for one of their niece's children.

series:34045.title: Sister Wives
series:34045.overview: Husband Kody Brown, along with his four wives (only one of which is legally married to Kody) and their combined 18 children, attempts to navigate life as a "normal" family in a society that shuns their lifestyle.

movie:1457866.title: THE FURTHER MIS-ADVENTURES OF CLIFF BOOTH
movie:1457866.original_title: THE FURTHER MIS-ADVENTURES OF CLIFF BOOTH
movie:1457866.overview: Eight years after the events of Once Upon a Time in... Hollywood, Cliff Booth returns to a changing Los Angeles. movie:1828305.title: Maarnami

Will their friendship sustain the brutal ascent of power where there is place for only one at the summit?

series:283356.title: Dr. Hassan
series:283356.overview: An Indian remake of the popular medical drama.

series:111474.title: Gabby's Dollhouse
series:111474.overview: This colorful series leads preschoolers room to room through a fantastical dollhouse of delightful mini-worlds and irresistible kitty characters.

movie:1637705.title: #Cult
movie:1637705.overview: A group of young boys head to a party expecting a night of fun, but soon discover the reality is far darker than they imagined. What starts as excitement spirals into terror, pushing them into a brutal fight for survival.

movie:1728763.title: Drones
movie:1728763.overview: A sleepwalking student, a mysterious miniature artist, an ancient witch, a doll house of trapped souls, and a cop cursed by love collide in a surreal world.

movie:1213243.title: Toxic
movie:1213243.overview: A powerful drug cartel pulls the strings behind a facade of sun-soaked beaches as a gritty, violent underworld power struggle emerges during the crumbling of Portuguese colonial rule.

series:319830.title: Pochamma

movie:1828332.overview: Multiple people chase after a sum of money, each trying to outwit and deceive the others. As trust and relationships crumble, the situation escalates into chaos involving police pursuit.

movie:1084409.title: A Talent for Murder
movie:1084409.overview: A young man travels from New York to Switzerland to try to persuade acclaimed thriller writer Patricia Highsmith to write one final installment of her Tom Ripley series, with his efforts gradually turning more sinister.

movie:1814023.title: Adhey Neevu Adhey Nenu
movie:1814023.overview: Sagar, a software engineer, and his wife Sri Valli live in a gated community in Hyderabad. As work consumes Sagar, a lonely Sri Valli is drawn to Karthik, a charming new neighbour in town on a project from Canada, until shocking truths about her husband surface and a crime turns all three lives upside down.

movie:1720201.title: Dulhaniya Le Aaeegi
movie:1720201.overview: Navya, the only daughter of powerful businessman Devi Prasad, is set for a grand wedding that soon goes off track due to unexpected twists. As secrets unfold and egos clash, the celebration turns into a modern-day swayamvar.

series:342466.title: Sathyameva
series:342466.overview: Haunted by an innocent client he couldn't save, Advocate Rajaram, a washed-up defence lawyer, takes up the dying plea of a man everyone called mad, to find a daughter missing for twenty years, and drags into the light a woman the powerful made sure would never be found.Filing the dead man's plea as a Habeas Corpus petition, the lawyer traces a twenty-year-old disappearance through an orphanage and a buried police file to a woman the powerful would rather stayed lost, and finds one last shot at the justice, and the redemption, that both of them were denied.

movie:1780407.title: Snoopy Presents: 12 Days of Snoopy
movie:1780407.overview: Eager to get off Santa's naughty list, Snoopy goes all out to be the nicest beagle in town.

movie:1620668.title: Mayookha

movie:1730915.title: Oru Vadakkan Velicham - A Northern Light
movie:1730915.overview: When a young man is taken in for questioning about the disappearance of a woman, a seemingly routine interrogation slowly unravels into something far more personal. movie:1702582.title: OM
movie:1702582.overview: A conversation in a music store between two people who have reunited after a year. Their lives have changed. New stories have emerged surrounding them and words many are reluctant to say.

movie:87513.title: Motor City
movie:87513.overview: In 1970s Detroit, John Miller falls for a local gangster's girl and lands in prison for a crime he didn't commit. With his life ruined, Miller plots revenge against the man who took his girl away.

movie:1628781.title: Iniyum

movie:1730215.title: City Lights
movie:1730215.overview: Follows two individuals who move from a village to Bengaluru, only to confront the harsh realities of survival in a fast-paced, indifferent city.

movie:1384528.title: O.M: Operation Mole
movie:1384528.overview: Set across the temple corridors of Tirupati and Tiruvannamalai, an elite undercover operative infiltrates a sprawling transnational red sanders syndicate. As criminal politics escalate, a covert task force launches Operation Mole to dismantle the cartel from within.

movie:1602830.title: Maharaja Hostel
movie:1602830.overview: A group of college students settle into what seems like an ordinary hostel, but things soon take a strange turn when a series of unexplained incidents begin to unfold. As their fun-filled hostel life descends into chaos, the students and their warden are forced to face the mysterious presence lurking within Maharaja Hostel.

movie:1400837.title: Other Mommy
movie:1400837.overview: Young Bela forms a relationship with a sinister entity in her home that looks uncannily like her own mother, drawing her into a terrifying and increasingly dark world.

movie:1209723.title: Yeh Prem Mol Liya
movie:1209723.overview: A heartfelt romantic family drama about two best friends whose close bond slowly turns into love. But one lie creates misunderstandings and conflicts, putting their relationship and family bonds to the test. The story explores love, sacrifice, understanding and the importance of family.

movie:1322273.title: Aakasamlo Oka Tara
movie:1322273.overview: A girl from a remote village dreams of becoming an astronaut and wishes to defy the odds and doubts from those around her.

series:342646.title: Teen Tigada
series:342646.overview: Teen Tigada is an emotional drama about ambition, unexpected love, and the meaning of family.

series:275204.overview: The story revolves around Bhuvan and his family's everyday lives, when an unexpected purchase leads to a series of events and depicts every common man's larger than life dreams.

movie:1434462.title: Melcow Pondicherry
movie:1434462.overview: A group of friends from Keralam embark on a trip to Pondicherry, where a series of unexpected events unfolds.

movie:1122573.title: In the Grey
movie:1122573.overview: A covert team of elite operatives are living in the shadows. When a ruthless despot steals a billion-dollar fortune, they're sent to take it back—an impossible heist that erupts into a deadly game of strategy, deception and survival.

movie:1510775.title: Gunmaaster G9
movie:1510775.overview: A man in love takes extreme measures to be with the woman he desires, facing off against a dangerous adversary.

series:233732.title: All The Love Our Hearts Carry
series:233732.original_title: Jo Bachay Hain Sang Samait Lo
series:233732.overview: The plot centers on Sikandar, a Harvard law student dealing with emotional trauma, and Liza, a gifted artist with a complicated past. The story explores human vulnerability, emotional resilience, and the enduring power of relationships

movie:1555847.title: Garividi Lakshmi
movie:1555847.overview: A gifted folk singer from North Andhra rises to fame through her captivating voice and Burra Katha performances, only to mysteriously disappear at the height of her popularity. Years later, a man sets out to unravel the mystery. What happened to Garividi Lakshmi?

series:97546.overview: Ted Lasso, an American football coach, moves to England when he's hired to manage a soccer team—despite having no experience. With cynical players and a doubtful town, will he get them to see the Ted Lasso Way?

movie:1533928.title: Bachelor Party D'eux
movie:1533928.overview: When urban chaos erupts around them, a band of honour-bound thieves must pull off a dangerous escape together, refusing to abandon each other despite deadly obstacles in their path.

movie:942411.title: Mrs.
movie:942411.overview: A newly wed finds herself in an overcooked and tasteless happily ever-after laced with patriarchal traditions.

movie:1570366.title: PANTHAM

series:336831.title: The Traitors (Telugu)
series:336831.overview: Twenty contestants play the ultimate game of trust and betrayal.

movie:1800255.title: Enemy Of The Smuggler
movie:1800255.overview: Inspired by real customs investigations, a relentless battle unfolds against organized smuggling networks, exposing the hidden world of coastal operations, airport cartels and the officers determined to stop them.

movie:1179380.title: Cosmic Samson

movie:1538497.title: Hexed
movie:1538497.overview: An impulsive and unconventional teenage girl named Billie discovers secret magical abilities which, once unleashed, hurtle her into a spectacle-filled journey out of suburbia and into a vast witch realm called Hexe. movie:1728047.title: Delivery Boy
